issues_and_pull_requests.title: Fix L2 findings: accessible, safe, static-first SpineFlow gallery
issues_and_pull_requests.body:
## What this fixes from Lincoln 2's independent review

This PR adds a **static-first, offline, accessible-by-design SpineFlow gallery** at the repository root, without overwriting the original `client/public/spineflow-v5.6.html` experiment or renaming SpineFlow.

### Changes
- Clear public-facing explanation and five preserved study themes (Heritage Study, Material Alchemist, Sax Sanctuary, Cyber Cell, Drive Home).
- Responsive HTML/CSS with natural scrolling, keyboard-operable study navigation, tab semantics, focus styles, native dialog, and reduced-motion support.
- No CDN, analytics, browser API keys, remote AI requests, chat transmission, untrusted `innerHTML`, or broken image-loading state in the new entrypoint.
- Per-study provenance/status labels, material assumptions, research questions and next steps. J.O.E. explicitly fictional; heritage content explicitly interpretive, not community-endorsed or verified.
- CSS abstract scene keeps the experimental visual language and works offline. It is not advertised as a 3D/engineering tool.
- Local allowlisted JSON summary export.
- Supported `node tools/build.cjs` and `node --test tests/gallery.test.cjs` with GitHub Actions validation.
- `REMEDIATION.md` records remaining gates and a manual test plan.

### Not changed / remaining blockers
- **License conflict:** root `LICENSE` says MIT, README says all rights reserved. Bart must decide; no silent relicense.
- Existing Vite/CRA files and pnpm lock remain for archival purposes but are **not** the new build entrypoint. Full cleanup can follow explicit approval.
- No actual screen-reader/device test, penetration test, live provider service, 3D terrain implementation or website deployment is claimed.
- The original experiment remains in its original location; new root entrypoint does not call its unsafe chat code.

### Independent review
See [Lincoln 2's source critique](https://github.com/Bartron773/2lincolns/blob/main/reviews/spineflow-tiny/2026-11-12-lincoln2/CRITIQUE.md).

### Review request
Bart and Brad: test the root `index.html` on desktop and mobile, review the five themes, and decide the license conflict before merging or publishing. Keep the branch draft until tests and human review are complete.

note: Git history and branch tips are preserved under archive/personal/*. GitHub issue/PR numbers, review threads, check runs, permissions and secrets are not Git objects. Source records remain at their original URLs. No credential values have been copied.
